errors.evidence: The phrase "две групи стълби" (two groups of bars) is an ambiguous way to describe a grouped bar chart. A clearer term would be "групирани стълбове" (grouped bars) to indicate that for each year, there is a group of two bars. The current wording could be misinterpreted as two separate large groups of bars.

errors.text_span: През 2019 година има 242 966 електрически автомобила, което представлява 2,9% от общия брой; през 2020 година има 536 186 електрически автомобила или 10,7%; през 2021 година - 878 092 електрически автомобила или 18%; през 2022 година - 1 126 682 електрически автомобила или 21,6%; и през 2023 година - 3 193 455 електрически автомобила, което е 22,3% от общия брой.
errors.evidence: The final sentence lists all 10 data points from the chart. While factually correct, this is excessively detailed and harms readability. A more effective description would summarize the trend or highlight key points, such as the starting and ending values, rather than listing every single value.

The description does not mention the existence or location of the chart's legend, which is located at the bottom center. Although the description explains what the colors represent, it omits mentioning the legend element itself.
